To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the face to face environment is superior to the online environment in the achievement of course objectives as measured by the post test instructor specific questions and 2) there is no difference in the achievement of the course objectives as measured either by the overall post test or the post test standardized items.

(1) there is no statistical difference between online and face toface delivery on the overall standardized test, (2) there is a statistically significant difference in favor of face to face delivery on the instructor specific standardized test, (3) there is no difference between online and f2f delivery on the instructor's overall test and (4) there is a significant difference in favor face to face delivery in the change in the instructor specific questions.

students in the face toface section have statistically significantly better overall scores and statistically significantly higher instructor specific post test scores than students in the online section.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relative effectiveness of online and face toface education in the context of a Principles of Macro economics course.
the question of whether or not online education is as good as face to face education and whether the answer to that question is the same for all students and all courses.
the relative effectiveness of online and face toface delivery of a college level Principles of Macroeconomic class.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the face toface delivery of the same course material is more effective than the online delivery of the same material.
the two delivery modes are equally effective in achieving student learning objectives.
the online and face toface sections are equally effective in achieving student learning objectives.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the face to face delivery is better than the online delivery.
the online delivery of a Principles of Macro Economics course is as effective as the face to face delivery.
the online mode was as effective as the face to face mode in achieving the instructor's course objectives.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the results of the online vs. face to face debate are not yet in.
online delivery may be as effective as face toface delivery in a well structured environment with a good instructor.
the use of random assignment to enrolment is critical to the validity of the results.
